description:
This request adds a data extension definition to the specified object type (e.g. Customer) so that extension data can be written to a particular object of that type (e.g., this customer, John Smith. A data extension definition must be created before data can be written to the data extension.

The `data_ext_def_add` wrapper from qbXML is also accepted. Returns the v2 request to send, and the webhook payload QuickBooks' answer arrives in (this operation's response_json: its data shape and the status codes to handle).

Possible errors (error.code / error.type; the call result explains each): 1030 unsupported_request, 3040 invalid_amount, 3070 string_too_long, 3150 missing_element, 3175 in_use, 3176 locked, 3180 cannot_save, 3210 invalid_value, 3220 not_authorized, 3231 request_not_processed, 3250 feature_not_enabled, 3260 insufficient_permission, 3261 personal_data_access_denied, 3262 payroll_subscription_required, 3263 read_only_access, 3264 merchant_services_subscription_required, 3270 missing_posting_account

data_ext_format_string.description: The string format required for the data extension.

data_ext_list_require.description: If `data_ext_list_require` is true, this data extension field is required to be entered in lists. The default value is false.

data_ext_name.description: The name of the data extension. If this is a custom field, `data_ext_name` will be visible as a label in the QuickBooks user interface.

data_ext_txn_require.description: If `data_ext_txn_require` is true, this data extension field is required to be entered in transaction. The default value is false.

data_ext_type.description: The field’s data type, which corresponds to a qbXML data type. In an IDataExtDefAdd request object, if this is a custom field, `data_ext_type` must be detSTR255TYPE.

include_qbxml.description: Also return the qbXML this compiles to, for debugging. Not part of the v2 request.

owner_id.description: `owner_id` identifies who owns the data extension. Use 0 for QuickBooks custom fields that appear in the UI, or use a GUID for private extensions owned by an app.

request_id.description: Your own label for the request, sent to QuickBooks as its qbXML `requestID` and echoed in the raw answer (`response_xml`); optional, since the answer's webhook already carries the request's `id`.

name: create_data_ext_def

body.description: The JSON body: the arguments you passed.

headers.description: Send with the request. Resent unchanged when no 201 came back, it answers with the request already queued.

qbxml.description: The qbXML it compiles to. Only with include_qbxml.

webhook.description: JSON Schema of the payload POSTed to webhook_url once QuickBooks answers, with this operation's response_json (data shape and status codes).
